angle: Unlike formula-first treatments of the same base-rate material, this video rebuilds Bayes' theorem from a librarian-versus-farmer counting story and a redraw-it-yourself 1x1 area square, so the formula becomes a proportion you can reconstruct rather than memorize.
angle_detail: Start at [02:54], where the 200-farmer/10-librarian count is turned into prior, likelihood and posterior by [07:44], then use [08:37]-[10:08] for the 1x1-square sketch to keep as your memory aid. Notation matches the course (vertical bar for conditioning); watch that the prior depends on the assumed reference population, a choice debated from [13:26] onward. Skip the treasure-hunt and AI name-drops around [00:14]-[00:25]: they are never worked through with numbers.
